name: Mage Hand: The Borrowed Reach
description: A narrow handbook with a glove-shaped stain on the cover. The first exercise is to lift a teacup from across the room, and the second is to do it without anyone noticing.
notes: The tome that teaches the Mage Hand spell (mw-e08.10). Item id equals the spell id so the cover art id is ui-book-cover-mage-hand. Licensed arcane magic, common. Study time is 30 minutes; the scroll of the same spell is scroll-of-mage-hand. Base value 140 sits in the economy tome band, a little above Ember: it is the more useful of the two first-step spells (tooUseful, constitution section 4).
